text:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — Crestline Logistics flagged a new use case: their field ops team wants in-field summaries and extraction (mobile SDK + edge cache) and is asking for Private/Dedicated options. They expect 3 extra teams, roughly 250–350 reqs/min peak, and want the work completed before renewal in ~3 months. Could be a >2x ARR expansion if we move fast, or a renewal risk if we stall.
Priya: Thanks — do we have a rough token estimate from their sample prompts?
Morgan: They sent a sample: avg prompt ~75 tokens, response ~120 tokens. Using 300 reqs/min -> ~57k tokens/min -> ~82M tokens/day. They said 2 regions (US + EMEA) eventually.
Diego: That scale pushes them out of our current shared quota comfortably. For Dedicated I'd recommend a baseline of 2 reserved nodes with autoscale to 4 for bursts, or a Private single-region deployment with VPC peering. I'll sketch cost/throughput numbers.
Leah: From enablement side, items to unblock: SSO/SCIM, VPC peering checklist, HIPAA/PII handling doc, and a short integration guide for mobile SDK. I can prepare a 1-pager and a 2hr enablement workshop.
Priya: Can we get an early architecture call with their infra folks? They mentioned slow network at some depots so edge cache + prefix caching will matter.
Diego: Scheduling — I'm available Wednesday 10–11 PT. Also will share a short perf matrix.
infrastructure-bot: deployment-quota-check: hosted_quota=3M tokens/day, reserved_capacity=0, recent_peak=1.8M tokens/day
Morgan: That's the problem — their projected 82M/day is >> hosted_quota. We need to propose Dedicated or Private.
Priya: Draft outreach to customer: "We can map this to Dedicated for predictable throughput and a Private option for data controls. Can we set a joint tech sync next week to run a sizing workshop?" Thoughts?
Leah: +1. If they sign Dedicated this quarter we should offer a rollout plan: canary in US, telemetry hooks to Console, and a short eval on one team first. I'll own enablement checklist.
Diego: I'll attach an early cost sketch in the thread after the call: rough numbers: Dedicated (2 reserved nodes) -> supports ~350 reqs/min with latency SLOs, Private (single region) -> more ops work but meets their compliance ask.
Morgan: Also flagging renewal lead — I'll loop in AE after we confirm dates. If we can secure a commitment for Dedicated, renewals look safe. If not, risk increases.
Priya: Action items: 1) Morgan schedule tech sync with customer + AE, 2) Diego produce preliminary sizing + cost, 3) Leah draft enablement 1-pager and workshop agenda, 4) Infra team to confirm feasibility for EMEA region.
Diego: I'll post the sizing doc here after the whiteboard.
Leah: I'll queue the workshop calendar invite and a short survey for their infra readiness.
Morgan: Thanks team — trying to move this to prioritized this week. :eyes:
